errors.where: purple valve cap at the top-front of the ball
errors.what: The cap is drawn almost as a full circle seen face-on, but it sits where the ball's surface turns up and away from the viewer. It should be a clearly narrower ellipse that follows the curve of the ball where the stripes meet.

cards.fix: Draw the purple cap where the stripes meet as a foreshortened ellipse lying on the curved surface of the ball, narrower top to bottom, matching the angle of the ball's surface.

errors.where: green spiral slide around the central blue pole
errors.what: The slide's coils don't form one consistent helix around the pole. The middle coil passes in front of the pole, while the upper and lower sections seem to sit on different sides at the same depth. Because of this, the overlaps can't be read as one continuous 3D spiral seen from the single raised camera used for the platform and floor.

cards.fix: Make the green slide one continuous helix that winds evenly around the central pole, with each coil overlapping the next in a consistent front/behind order. Show the inside of the trough from the same raised viewpoint as the platform and floor tiles.

errors.what: The door and frame are drawn as a flat, straight-on elevation with no inner jamb depth, yet the knob sticks out to the right as if seen from the left. The stone step below is also seen from above. The parts suggest different viewpoints.

cards.fix: Use one slightly raised, slightly off-center viewpoint: show the inner thickness of the door frame on one side and draw the knob and step from that same angle.
